meanings.note: Russian determiner/pronoun ('no ... at all') agreeing in gender, number, and case with the noun phrase it specifies.

забрать.gloss: to take back, to take away

meanings.en: to take back, to take away
meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (root 'брать'). Used in Russian as an perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to take back', forming an aspectual pair with 'забирать'.

examples.trans: I took back my own sauté pan.
He wants to pick Styopa up.

examples.text: Я забрала из сейфа твой сотейник.

meanings.note: Russian perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to buy', forming an aspectual pair with 'покупать'; conjugates for person and number in the present/future and agrees in gender in the past tense.

examples.text: Я эту сковородку купил во Франции.

meanings.note: International borrowing in '-ция' (from Latin '-tio'), declined as a regular feminine noun meaning 'France'.

examples.text: Я эту сковородку купил во Франции.

переживать.gloss: to worry, to fret; to go through
